fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in computer science at Warwick? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Computer Science MSc (course code P-G5PD) is a **1-year**, full-time course on Warwick's campus near Coventry. It starts on **27 September 2027**. It is **not a conversion course**: it is designed for technically minded graduates in computer science, mathematics or the physical sciences.

You can take the broad Computer Science pathway or a specialist route in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Analytics or Cyber Security. You study three core modules in your first term, then options and a dissertation due in September. Class sizes are 20 to 50 students, with 12 to 16 contact hours a week. Warwick's Computer Science department was ranked 4th in the UK in REF 2021.

For the wider university, see our [University of Warwick page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-warwick).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a First or a **high 2:1** in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or another quantitative degree. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade; a high 2:1 is the upper part of that band.

**Indian marks.** Warwick sorts Indian institutions into 3 categories. For a 2:1 it asks for **60%** or 6.0/10 from Category 1 (IITs, NITs, IIITs, top NIRF institutions and others), **65%** or 6.5/10 from Category 2 (state and central universities) and **70%** or 7.0/10 from Category 3 (private and deemed universities). For a First it asks for **65%** or 6.5/10 (Category 1), **75%** or 7.5/10 (Category 2) and **80%** or 8.0/10 (Category 3). Find your institution on the [India entry requirements page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international/countryinformation/southasia/india/india-entry-requirements/). The course asks for a high 2:1, and the India page does not say what that means in Indian marks, so aim above these minimums. Degrees completed entirely by distance or online study are not accepted.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course is in Warwick's Band A: **IELTS 6.5** overall, with no component below **6.0**.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Warwick's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£39,330** for 2027-28, from the Warwick fees table.

Warwick is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £39,330 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£51,879** |

The sum is £39,330 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £51,879. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Application fee and deposit.** Neither is listed on the course page.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Scholarships: NOT CONFIRMED.** Warwick lists its scholarships through a [search tool](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/scholarships-and-bursaries/scholarships/), filtered by course, nationality and level of study. We did not find a named 2027 award for this course. Search with Postgraduate Taught and Computer Science selected, and check whether any award can be combined with others before you count on it.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | All applicants | 2 August 2027 (on-time deadline) | Warwick postgraduate online application |

Warwick still accepts late applications, but cannot promise to process them in time. Indian students need time for a CAS and visa, so apply months before August.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure your degree subject and marks fit your institution's category.
2. **Prepare your documents.** You need transcripts, your degree certificate, one academic reference and your English test result.
3. **Apply online.** Use the Apply link on the [course page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-computer-science/) before 2 August 2027.
4. **Accept your offer.** Meet any conditions. The university then issues your CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** The course prepares you for roles in the technology sector, PhD study or commercial research.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a strong BTech, BE or BSc in computer science, maths or physics
- your marks clear the 2:1 line for your institution's category
- you want a 1-year course on a campus outside London

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in a non-quantitative subject, because this is not a conversion course
- you need a scholarship to go, because no named award for this course is confirmed

faq_json.q: Is the Warwick MSc Computer Science a conversion course?
faq_json.a: No. You need a First or high 2:1 in computer science, maths, statistics, physics or another quantitative subject.

faq_json.q: How much does the Warwick MSc Computer Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £39,330 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the year comes to £51,879.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: For a 2:1, Warwick asks for 60%, 65% or 70%, depending on your institution's category.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: The on-time deadline is 2 August 2027. Warwick accepts late applications but cannot promise to process them in time.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Warwick need?
faq_json.a: Band A: IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. The course page does not mention GRE.
